what: the registered numbers of every E207 rule (frozen before any E207 datum); the scorer reads this file and pins its sha256

verdict.form: a rule's verdict: PASS if at least 90% of its scored cases (time) or points (energy) pass; FAIL otherwise; TOO FEW under 10 scored; NO DATA with none

T1.what: cycles an op, the wall (cycles_max / passes / ops), per case
T1.held_out_e206_source: compare_e206.json > table > 'all | cycles an op, wall (the slowest minion) | v1_held_out'

T2.what: cycles an op, the counter's mean (the host's cycles_per_op), per case
T2.held_out_e206_source: compare_e206.json > table > 'all | cycles an op, the counter's mean | v1_held_out'

T3.held_out_e206_source: compare_e206.json > table > 'all | seconds a GEMM | v1_held_out'

E1.what: J over idle given the measured seconds, per point (at 3 W and above)
E1.held_out_e206_source: compare_e206.json > table > 'all | J over idle, given the measured seconds | v1_held_out'
E1.loeo_all_source: holdout_v1.json > 'energy pmem1 on time v1_r1conf_dramr0_t2us' > stats > 'LOEO | J over idle given t (>= 3 W) | all'

E2.what: J over idle with the seconds forecast, per point (at 3 W and above)
E2.held_out_e206_source: compare_e206.json > table > 'all | J over idle, seconds forecast | v1_held_out'
E2.loeo_all_source: holdout_v1.json > 'energy pmem1 on time v1_r1conf_dramr0_t2us' > stats > 'LOEO | J over idle t forecast (>= 3 W) | all'

E3.what: J with the card at rest given the measured seconds and rest, per point
E3.held_out_e206_source: compare_e206.json > table > 'all | J at rest, given the measured seconds (measured rest) | v1_held_out'
E3.loeo_all_source: holdout_v1.json > 'energy pmem1 on time v1_r1conf_dramr0_t2us' > stats > 'LOEO | J at rest given t | all'

E4.what: J with the card at rest with the seconds forecast (the measured rest), per point
E4.held_out_e206_source: compare_e206.json > table > 'all | J at rest, seconds forecast (measured rest) | v1_held_out'
E4.loeo_all_source: holdout_v1.json > 'energy pmem1 on time v1_r1conf_dramr0_t2us' > stats > 'LOEO | J at rest t forecast | all'

band_rule: twice the larger of MM1-v1's held-out rms on E206's fold and its leave-one-experiment-out rms over all points (where recorded), rounded up to a whole percent; a case or point passes when |measured / forecast - 1| <= the band

watts.rule: at these points E1 and E2 read |W measured - W forecast| <= band_w (W = J over idle / t); E3 and E4 stay relative
watts.sd_rep_method: E206 arm A (data-e206.json): per point the sample sd of its two runs' W over idle; pooled = sqrt(mean of the variances)

rules.H1: cycles an op, the wall, per case: MM1-v1 (cycles_per_op_wall) against F1 (F1_cycles_per_op)
rules.H2: cycles an op, the counter's mean, per case: MM1-v1 (cycles_per_op_mean) against F1 (F1_cycles_per_op)
rules.H3: J over idle given the measured seconds, per point both price: MM1-v1 against F2
rules.H4: J over idle with the seconds forecast, per point both price: MM1-v1 against F2

head_to_head.d: d = |ln(measured / other)| - |ln(measured / MM1-v1)| (in watts at the points scored in watts: |W - W_other| - |W - W_v1|)
head_to_head.test: exact two-sided sign test (binomial, p = 1/2) on the untied cases

reported_head_to_head: J over idle given / forecast: MM1-v1 against F1 (points F1 prices)
J over idle given / forecast: F1 against F2

smoke.rule: the smoke's cycles an op (the host's counter mean) within 50-250% of MM1-v1's cycles_per_op_mean

f1f2_reported.what: F1's and F2's own E206 rules (C1, S1, S4 inside their bands; S2 within 10%, S3 within 5%) read on the day's points: REPORTED
